title: Workflow store module: per-workflow state records
action: New lib module workflow-store.mjs: records at .bee/runtime/workflows/<workflow-id>/state.json with schema {id, feature, phase, mode, plan_rev, gates:{name:{approved, approved_for_plan_rev}}, summary, next_action, status, created_at}. workflow_id generated (short uuid), NEVER the feature slug. CRUD + list + per-workflow lock name workflow:<id> (reuse lock.mjs primitives). Atomic writes, corrupt-record typed refusals mirroring lanes. Unit tests for create/read/update/list/lock isolation (two workflows never contend). Canonical source: skills/bee-hive/templates/ (vendored to .bee/bin/ + plugin mirrors). Regen inside this cell after the code change: node scripts/render_plugin_skill_trees.mjs; node skills/bee-hive/scripts/onboard_bee.mjs --repo-root . --apply; node scripts/release_manifest.mjs --write (+ impact_registry --write if suites changed).

truths: two workflows mutate concurrently without sharing a lock (test proves no contention)
corrupt record refuses loudly, never silent fallback
prohibitions: no global 'state' lock taken by any workflow-store operation

verify: node scripts/run_verify.mjs --impacted && node scripts/release_manifest.mjs --check && node scripts/ledger_parity.mjs --check

trace.outcome: workflow-store.mjs: new leaf module for per-workflow state records (.bee/runtime/workflows/<id>/state.json), createWorkflow/readWorkflow/updateWorkflow/listWorkflows + withWorkflowLock(workflow:<id>), typed WORKFLOW_MISSING/WORKFLOW_CORRUPT refusals, workflow_id!=feature enforced, C4 isolation proven (never imports claims.mjs/state.mjs, never takes sessions/state lock). 13 red-first-proven tests, full suite green, regen artifacts committed.
